items.title: Normalize the actual positive and negative determinant Haar priors

source.anchor: Appendix B.2.2 first proof paragraph, half-mass clause preceding Eq20; literal normalized restriction priors are explicit background expansion.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. The source n>=3 application is explicitly extended to the elementary n>=1 background fact; the omitted symmetry justification is supplied here.

items.statement: Let n be a positive natural number and mu the existing normalized Borel Haar probability on the full real orthogonal group O(n). Put Cplus={O:det(O)=1} and Cminus={O:det(O)=-1}. Then mu(Cplus)=mu(Cminus)=1/2, and both literal measures 2 times mu restricted to Cplus and 2 times mu restricted to Cminus are probability measures. All determinant-event measurability, partition, negative-determinant witness and invariance requirements are established internally. This explicitly generalizes the source application n>=3 to n>=1; dimension0 is excluded because its negative determinant event is empty. No Gaussian target-mixture measure or TV conclusion is asserted.
assumptions: Positive natural dimension n>=1; source application retains n>=3. The n=0 obstruction is explicit.
Identical actual normalized full-O(n) Borel Haar law; no arbitrary measure, SO replacement, equal-mass assumption or supplied negative-determinant matrix.
No kappa, ell, Gaussian, integrability or query-budget hypotheses are relevant to this probability-normalization prerequisite.

obligations.label: Actual half-mass and normalized literal restrictions

bindings.boundary: Actual full-Haar component masses and literal2*restriction mixing-prior probabilities only. No actual Gaussian-family kernel/target mixtures, H expectation split, TV, adaptive posterior/transcript, sphere/Poisson, parameter choice or either main lower bound. n>=1 is a disclosed background generalization; n=0 excluded. Source omits the elementary symmetry argument; the supplied background proof is not attributed as an explicit author proof.

assumption_deltas.source: Full Haar determinant components have probability1/2 in the n>=3 single-block application; the symmetry proof is omitted.
assumption_deltas.lean: Same actual full Haar and determinant events, explicitly generalized to n>=1; additionally proves the literal2*restriction laws are probabilities. Every symmetry/partition/measurability ingredient is internal.
assumption_deltas.reason: The elementary positive-dimension background fact supplies the source application without adding a premise. Dimension0 is excluded. The source omission is made explicit, without claiming mixtures or TV.
